collectible.title: Ribbon of Victory
collectible.text: In recognition of your achievement, May awarded you this ribbon!

collectible.title: May's Sunset Secret
collectible.subtitle: Outfit Unlock
collectible.text: May competed as a coordinator in the Wallace Cup Pokémon Contest in this exciting midriff-baring outfit! Peel back the outer layers and judge for yourself if her summer secret is worthy of a prize.
collectible.unlock: Play and win a game against May and only one other character. The second character needs to be Cynthia or Nagisa.
